title: Brother Harold in Les Hite's band
summary: He and Harold played in Les Hite's band briefly; Harold is now a solo pianist.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: You also mentioned that at one point you and your brother Harold worked in the same orchestra. Which
Yes, that was Les Hite's band in Los Angeles out of the Cotton Club. I didn't work very long with him. Just for a short time.
You were there quite a while --
Oh, I was there but he wasn't no. He's -- he usually plays by himself. He doesn't play with orchestra at all.
He still -- oh yeah, he's still playing.
He's solo pianist out at the Beverly Wilshire in the [Bedrina] Room. So, he's worked practically all his life by himself that way.
He has quite a following in Los Angeles.
